cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: The Pattern
cards.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. Two office biscuits are missing. We've got an organised operation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. A confession this quick suggests training.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they're recruiting through hunger. This goes higher than the biscuit tin.
